items.docs: Returns lightweight IP information about the current IP including ASN details, country, and continent information.

info.name: IPinfo Returns Lightweight IP Information About the Provided IP

params.name: ip
params.description: A single IPv4 or IPv6 IP address.

items.docs: Returns lightweight IP information about the provided IP including ASN details, country, and continent information. For bogon/private IPs, returns a response with bogon: true.
